name: Tim Nelson
hometown: Wherever the strategy pattern is used
bio: Good to meet you all! I'm a first-generation college student who attended community college, a commuter-focused state college, the 'college' of an industry job, a STEM university, and... now teaches at Brown. Someone who enjoys puns might call this a collage of colleges, although not quite a universe of universities.

name: Sana Saab
bio: Hi! I'm Sana, and I'm a senior from Michigan studying CS. I like learning new types of dance (albeit badly), trying out new clubs and hobbies, and going on adventures!

name: Marissa Shaffer
bio: Hi, I'm Marissa, and I'm a senior from Philadelphia studying STS (ask me about it!) & CS. Outside of class, I'm a circus artist, a cappella singer, cat parent, and NYT puzzle enthusiast. I'm excited to see what you all build this semester!

name: Joshua Bala
bio: Hey, my name is Joshua Bala and I'm a Senior studying pure cs. Big fan of basketball, anime, boba and any apple deserts. Also I dabble in hiking and biking. Very excited for this semester and TAing this class!!!!!!!

name: Aisosa Idahosa
bio: Hi everyone! I'm a junior from the Philly area studying CS and (maybe) MCM. In my free time, I love reading, crocheting, and recently I've been getting into ceramics! Super excited to TA this class and meet all of y'all!

name: Alondra Perez
bio: Heyy! I’m Alondra, a senior studying CS from California. When not coding, I love to spend my time at India Point Park while enjoying some Kow Kow, making some pottery, or trying out a new pastry somwhere! So excited to TA this semester and meeting everyone!!

name: Ellie Hong
bio: HI! I’m Ellie, a junior studying CS from Seattle, WA. Outside of the CIT, you’ll find me food crawling, binging rom-coms, or indulging in my Scrabble addiction. Let’s have a blast this semester!

name: Yuyuan Huang
bio: Hi! I’m Yuyuan, a junior from Massachusetts studying CS and IAPA. When I’m not thinking about socially responsible computing (SRC) and source code (src/), I love writing poetry, playing word games, reading, photography, being outside, and all things mango. Super excited for the semester!
